messages:
Maya: Quick RFC follow-up — propose we introduce an "adjacency fence" layer to encapsulate sidecar/adapter calls between enrichers and the runtime. Problem: constant churn in enrichers causes API drift and test fragility.
Alex: +1 for the idea. Can you sketch the boundary surface? small interface + pub/sub? I worry about latency.
Maya: Goal: thin sync HTTP/gRPC shim that normalizes contracts and owns retries, metrics, auth. Observability ownership moves to fence: traces, per-tenant histograms, sanitizer for noisy logs.
Sridhar: How will this interact with existing KV cache ownership? We can't add a hop for hotpath token fetches.
Maya: Agree — we'll gate hotpath via routing rules: traffic-preserving pins for latency-sensitive flows. For others, fence becomes default. Plan: iterative rollout per tenant group, feature-flagged, 3 sprints.
Tasha: What's the plan for tech-debt paydown? Are we extracting code or rewriting?
Maya: We extract adapters into the fence repo, add backwards-compatible shims in the enrichers for 1 release. Debt buckets: adapter duplication, flaky tests, undocumented semantics. Each bucket assigned to a sprint.
Alex: Can we add a skeleton api? Example:
```
# fence v1
POST /invoke
{ "source": "enricher_name", "payload": {...} }
```
Response: 200 + {result, meta.trace_id}

Sridhar: perf guardrails? We should measure p50/p95 and a counters per-call. Also circuit-breaker defaults.
Maya: Yes — fence exposes metrics: fence.request_latency_{p50,p95}, fence.errors, fence.kv_hits. We'll own dashboards and alerts. InfraBot: new dashboard created: https://grafana/redwood/d/adj-fence
Tasha: Rollout checklist?
Maya: 1) API shim + contract doc; 2) unit + e2e tests; 3) shadow proxy for 2 weeks; 4) canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%; 5) deprecate old direct calls after metrics stable.
Alex: How much work estimate?
Maya: Rough: 2 engineers * 6 weeks to extract + tests + dashboards. Migration ops: 1 engineer 3 weeks.
Sridhar: Risk: duplication of auth logic. We should centralize auth into a library used by fence and enrichers until cutover.
Maya: Agreed — add auth-lib step. Also add lint and contract checks in CI.
Tasha: Volunteers: I'll own the test harness, Alex can take observability, Maya will drive API + extraction. Sridhar ops review.
Maya: Sweet — I'll put RFC update + migration timeline in the repo today. @everyone if no objections I'll kick off sprint tickets tomorrow :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sridhar: :+1:
Tasha: :shipit:
